articles.title: SeaVerse Launches World's First AI Native Platform, "All in AI Native" Leads the Forward-Looking Revolution in AI Creation
articles.mainIdea: SeaVerse Launches World's First AI Native Platform, "All in AI Native" Leads the Forward-Looking Revolution in AI Creation
articles.summary: CNW Group: SeaVerse Launches World's First AI Native Platform, "All in AI Native" Leads the Forward-Looking Revolution in AI Creation. On January 10, 2026, SeaVerse announced the global launch of the world's first AI-native creation and deployment platform. SeaVerse integrates large language models, image generation, video generation, and AI agents, enabling users to package any creative idea into a product—demo, application, or web page—with just a single prompt. SeaVerse addresses the challenge of fragmented AI tools by emphasizing "All in AI Native," representing a forward-looking revolution for AI creators and teams.
